<a id="what-a-law-of-the-whole-and-no-part-takes--整体而无部分之律所需"></a>
# What a law of the whole and no part takes

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-a-law-of-the-whole-and-no-part-takes` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](what-a-law-of-the-whole-and-no-part-takes.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With numbered conditions, a counterexample to the least coupling, like every law of the whole and no part, exists exactly where a rule decides of every Boolean sequence whether it is false throughout: WLPO as a rule. The decision of vanishing is exactly LPO as a rule.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A number read off levels is changed by no condition where levels differing at one condition only give it alike; exactly then levels agreeing from some condition on give it alike, the conditions below changed one at a time: what no part changes, only the tail sets. (`Becoming.ChangedByNoCondition`, `Becoming.ChangedByNoCondition.eq_of_agree_from`, `Becoming.ChangedByNoCondition.of_agree_from`)
2. The law of a whole exchanges at every step a number read off the levels at step 0. Where no condition changes the number, it reads what has stood, is insensitive to every condition and reads through the conditions from any one on; where the number differs, it does not read through what it is sensitive to, nor finitely many conditions, and has no least coupling. The tail law is that of the indicator of vanishing. (`Becoming.wholeLaw`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_reads_from`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_insensitive`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_sensitive`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_through_from`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_through_sensitive`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_readsFinitely`, `Becoming.wholeLaw_no_least_coupling`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_changedByNoCondition`, `Becoming.tailLaw_eq_wholeLaw`)
3. Mixing two histories along a Boolean sequence ends by comparing two numbers, which is decided, so the mix gives a rule deciding, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout. A law insensitive at a step to every condition that still differs there, and every counterexample to the least registration, each give such a rule; the rule gives the weak limited principle of omniscience. (`Becoming.mixedDecision`, `Becoming.insensitiveDiffersDecision`, `Becoming.notThroughSensitiveDecision`, `Becoming.WLPO.of_rule`)
4. Given such a rule, whether levels vanish from condition N on is decided, and whether they vanish from no condition on is decided by the rule again. This indicator is changed by no condition, tells levels all 0 from levels all 1, and sums to 1 with the indicator of vanishing where that is given; its law reads what has stood, is insensitive to every condition and still differs. (`Becoming.Tail.nonzero`, `Becoming.Tail.eq_zero_of_nonzero_false`, `Becoming.Tail.levelsFrom`, `Becoming.ListTests.false_of_not_true`, `Becoming.Tail.add_eq`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom_true`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom_of`, `Becoming.vanishesFrom_never_iff`, `Becoming.neverIndicator`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_eq_one`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_eq_zero`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_eq_of_agree`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_changedByNoCondition`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_zeros`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_ones`, `Becoming.neverIndicator_add_vanishIndicator`, `Becoming.neverLaw`, `Becoming.neverLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.neverLaw_insensitive`, `Becoming.neverLaw_not_sensitive`, `Becoming.neverLaw_differs`)
5. With the conditions numbered by the natural numbers, a number changed by no condition that still differs, a law insensitive at a step to every condition that still differs there, and a counterexample to the least coupling each exist exactly where a rule decides, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout. (`Becoming.changedByNoCondition_iff_rule`, `Becoming.insensitive_differs_iff_rule`, `Becoming.not_through_sensitive_iff_rule`)
6. The decision of vanishing gives a rule deciding, of every Boolean sequence, whether it has a true; such a rule decides vanishing in two passes, whether some level from N on is above 0 for each N, then whether the answer is no for some N. So the two exist exactly together; the rule gives the weak rule and the limited principle of omniscience. (`Becoming.ListTests.false_of_not`, `Becoming.ListTests.not_eq_true_of_false`, `Becoming.lpoRuleOfVanishDecision`, `Becoming.raisedFrom`, `Becoming.raisedFrom_false`, `Becoming.raisedFrom_of`, `Becoming.vanishDecisionOfLPORule`, `Becoming.wlpoRuleOfLPORule`, `Becoming.LPO.of_rule`, `Becoming.vanishDecision_iff_lpoRule`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A rule deciding, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout (or whether it has a true), and the decision of vanishing, are written in as hypotheses where used, never assumed; the theorems of omniscience number the conditions by the natural numbers.
- Equality of numbers is decided where histories are compared, and of conditions where they are mixed, as in Becoming.Sensitivity; no premise is added.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the proposition WLPO gives a rule: that step chooses a function from a relation, which the core does not assume; so the equivalences are stated for rules.
- Whether the weak rule gives the limited principle's rule or the decision of vanishing, so whether the tail law takes strictly more than a counterexample needs; as propositions WLPO does not give LPO (Akama–Berardi–Hayashi–Kohlenbach 2004).
- Given the rule, reading what has stood does not imply reading through what one is sensitive to. Witness: `Becoming.wholeLaw_not_through_sensitive`.
- What a counterexample gives where the conditions are not numbered by the natural numbers; sensitivity read in temporal order; a measure of dependence.
- **Counterexample:** The law of levels that never vanish (given the rule): it reads what has stood, is insensitive to every condition and still differs: a counterexample to the least coupling built from the weak limited principle of omniscience as a rule alone. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Tail.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026, the goal: “move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”. This result answers the first item of the next_delta of sensitivity-is-the-least-registration: the exact strength of a counterexample's existence. Readings (the AI's, taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43): what depends on the whole and on no part of it is given exactly where it can be decided, of every unending sequence of yes and no, whether it says no throughout; with the conditions numbered, the least coupling fails exactly at this omniscience and needs no more of it, and the core does not assume it. Read as whether levels never vanish, a whole of this kind takes only the weak rule; read as whether they vanish eventually, a related whole, classically its complement but in the core another law, takes the rule of the limited principle. The mathematics is standard: the weak limited principle of omniscience of constructive reverse mathematics (Bridges and Richman 1987; the limited principle is Bishop's, 1967), stated here as a rule.
